blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s plan to summon Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan over his remarks that the Philippines could easily lose in a conflict with China topped INQToday’s afternoon newscast. Also in the lineup were the expected rollback in gasoline prices and a slight hike in diesel prices next week, as well as Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp accusing the Marcos administration of political persecution over an NBI probe into her alleged misdeclared properties. /dp READ: Marcos to summon Chinese envoy over threatening remarks...
